rounds.response: Thank you for the detailed numbers; I am updating our draft multi-year models to include your $110k W-2 salary, $40-50k retirement target, and $30k equipment budget for internal review. Regarding invoice timing, it is a perfectly legal, standard practice for cash-basis taxpayers to delay sending late-year invoices until late December to defer income, provided you do not run afoul of "constructive receipt" by holding onto a check received before year-end. Your retirement goal aligns perfectly with a Solo 401(k) structure under an S Corp, which will allow you to maximize contributions while minimizing overall self-employment taxes.
